scope: Isolated actual GPU stale-one-pass fault test on selected former Empty silhouette pixels. Baseline passing probes include current-section depth/normal matches and separately counted absence-only probes whose rays miss current section meshes. Absence-only probes validate finite actual depth farther than 1 mm behind the former surface, not background depth/normal agreement. Rasterized historical triangles must trigger the same FAIL_POSSIBLE_STALE_DEPTH while current normal/color and real renderer state remain unchanged. This does not validate every pixel, shadow, reflection or temporal history.
source: Actual HDRP cameraDepthBuffer and cameraNormalBuffer at BeforePostProcess, copied on the GPU; historical uploaded world-space triangles drawn by CommandBuffer.DrawMesh into a private copy of linear eye depth.
expectedFailure: The same SectionPixelAuditor.Validate must report FAIL_POSSIBLE_STALE_DEPTH at a baseline-passing former-empty-silhouette pixel.
writes: Three new private ARGBFloat RTs only. No writes to camera color/depth/normal, no changes to real scene Mesh objects or materials. The private copy uses Min blending to retain the nearer linear depth.

baseline.scope: Actual HDRP depth/normal readback versus current uploaded mesh ray intersections at sampled interior/near-edge pixels. Historical Empty silhouettes also test selected stale-depth pixels. A former silhouette with hasExpectedSectionSurface=false has no current section ray hit: PASS_FORMER_SURFACE_ABSENT means only that finite actual depth lies more than 1 mm behind the old surface; current background depth/normal agreement is NOT_VALIDATED and does not increment matchedDepth/matchedNormals. Other scene occluders are classified separately. A disagreement within 1/128 pixel of a projected triangle edge is NOT_VALIDATED_RASTER_BOUNDARY, never a passing normal/depth match; it bounds subpixel raster coverage ambiguity. This does not validate every pixel, final color, shadows, reflections, or temporal history.
